title: feat(AdvancedPaste): add Paste as Rich Text option natively

status.label: Local validation running
status.detail: Exact upstream-head AdvancedPaste validation failed: build-essentials and direct AdvancedPaste build both fail at PowerToys.Interop with LNK2019/LNK1120 because Constants.idl/Constants.h declare AdvancedPasteRichTextMessage() but upstream Constants.cpp has no implementation; the same build also stops on unrelated ZoomIt C4819 treated as error. Resume by adding the missing upstream implementation, then rebuild the exact head with the code-page warning fixed or suppressed in the environment.

blockers.detail: The exact upstream head declares winrt::PowerToys::Interop::implementation::Constants::AdvancedPasteRichTextMessage() in Constants.idl and Constants.h, but Constants.cpp does not define it. The AdvancedPaste validation consequently fails with LNK2019 followed by LNK1120 while linking PowerToys.Interop. The same build also stops on ZoomIt C4819 treated as an error under the active code page.
blockers.remediation: Resume the fork review/build trace by adding the missing Constants.cpp implementation on the fork side, then rerun exact-upstream validation after the upstream head includes the corresponding implementation; separately fix or suppress the ZoomIt code-page warning in the local build environment.
